meta.defaultScope: US domestic, main-cabin economy, one-way per passenger
meta.note: Single source of truth. api/scripts/generate-seed.mjs generates api/seed.sql from this file; the frontend imports it for prerendered content pages and as an explicitly-dated offline fallback. Every record carries provenance. Records with status 'unverified' have NOT been checked against the airline source by a data steward and are surfaced in the UI as 'Review pending'.

statusValues.verified: A named data steward compared this record against source_url on verified_at.
statusValues.unverified: Value carried over from an earlier build. Source URL is recorded so it can be checked, but no steward has confirmed it.
statusValues.assumption: Not published as a single figure by the airline. PackRight applies this as a clearly-labelled planning assumption, never as a quoted price.

assumptions.label: Oversized personal item
assumptions.change_note: Placeholder retained from the initial MVP build. Airlines do not publish a single flat oversize charge for personal items; the real outcome is usually gate-checking at that airline's carry-on or checked-bag rate. Displayed as a planning assumption only.

assumptions.label: Carry-on too large at the gate
assumptions.change_note: Placeholder retained from the initial MVP build. Gate-check outcomes vary by airline, fare and airport. Displayed as a planning assumption only.

assumptions.label: Checked bag over the weight limit
assumptions.change_note: Fallback only. Airlines publish overweight charges in bands that differ per airline, and those bands are now carried on each airline record, so this assumption is applied only where an airline publishes no band for the bag in hand.

assumptions.label: Third and each additional checked bag
assumptions.change_note: Placeholder retained from the initial MVP build. Displayed as a planning assumption only.

airlines.name: Lufthansa
airlines.scope: United States to Germany, Economy Class, one-way, per passenger, paid at the airport

Carry-on 55 x 40 x 23 cm (21.7 x 15.7 x 9.1 in) up to 8 kg (18 lb) and personal item 40 x 30 x 15 cm (15.7 x 11.8 x 5.9 in) are unchanged, as are the 23 kg (50 lb) and 158 cm (62 linear in) checked limits. airlines.name: Sun Country Airlines
airlines.source_title: Sun Country Airlines - Bags and Optional Services
airlines.scope: US domestic, one-way, per passenger, paid at the airport (Sun Country prices each bag for each flight, so it publishes no single base fee)
airlines.change_note: Checked against the airline's own pages on 2026-11-04 (the airline's live site is suncountry.com; suncountryair.com redirects to Hawaiian Airlines' site). The under-seat item is 17 x 13 x 9 in and is free on every reservation. The overhead bag is 24 x 16 x 11 in up to 35 lb and is a paid add-on. The checked limit is 62 linear in and 50 lb. Sun Country states that bag prices vary by flight and directs travellers to its own Explore Bag Prices tool, so no single base fee is published and the base fee is left unpriced rather than quoted from a third party. Overweight bands are published: 51-60 lb 25 USD, 61-70 lb 50 USD, 71-80 lb 75 USD, 81-90 lb 100 USD, 91-99 lb 125 USD; a bag of 63 linear in or more is 100 USD. Bags of 70 lb or more are not accepted to and from Canada, Jamaica and Puerto Rico, and nothing over 80 linear in or 100 lb is accepted.

airlines.name: Allegiant Air
airlines.source_title: Allegiant Air - Carry-On and Checked Baggage Policy, Size & Fees
airlines.scope: US domestic, main-cabin economy, one-way, per passenger (Allegiant prices every bag for the route and the date, and its own calculator labels its figures estimates)
airlines.change_note: Checked against the airline's own page on 2026-11-04. Allegiant allows one free personal item that must be stored completely under the seat in front of you, one carry-on bag per passenger that must fit in the overhead bin, and up to four pre-purchased checked bags of up to 50 lb and 80 linear inches. It publishes no dimensions for the personal item or the carry-on, and no single bag price: its own bag fee calculator says "bag fees listed are estimates and may be subject to change at the time of booking or check-in". The base checked-bag fee and the carry-on fee are therefore left unpriced rather than quoted from an estimate, and no overweight or oversize amount is recorded: Allegiant states that additional charges apply for a bag over 50 lb or over 80 linear inches, but publishes the figure only through that calculator. NOTE: Allegiant and Sun Country announced a proposed merger on 11 January 2026 which was still awaiting regulatory approval on the date of this check.
